headline: HOUTHIS 🍆 CLAIM 🏝️ MAJOR ADVANCE in Yemen and TIGHTEN 💪 Grip on RED SEA 🚢 Lane
text:
The HOUTHIS 🏴‍☠️ ESCALATED 🧨 fighting last week and have now reportedly TAKEN OVER 🏰 a strategic ISLAND 🏝️ in the RED SEA 🌊 after launching a LIGHTNING ⚡ offensive that left everyone in the region DOWN BAD 😵!! Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis have claimed a MAJOR ADVANCE 🚀 on the western Red Sea coast consolidating their GRIP 🤝 on the key international SHIPPING ROUTE 🚢 like they just edged the whole strait into SUBMISSION 🫡. A source from Yemen's internationally recognised government spilled to the BBC 📻 that the group SEIZED 🏴 Perim Island at the mouth of the waterway in the Bab al-Mandab Strait turning that narrow CHOKEPOINT 🥾 into their personal playground 🍑.

It comes a day after the Houthis CAPTURED 🏆 the strategic port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed pro-government forces according to military sources and now a Yemeni military official told AFP that the Houthis CONTROL 🛡️ the entire coastline baby they are absolutely COOKING 🔥 the opposition!! The Houthis earlier said they posed NO THREAT 🚫 to international shipping but reiterated their threat to TARGET VESSELS 🎯 from Saudi Arabia only leaving everyone wondering if WAB DADDY's crew is about to get RAILED 💦 by these drone-happy rebels. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman the country's de facto ruler has personally PRESSED 🤳 US President Donald Trump to take military action against the Houthis during their rapid advance two sources familiar with the matter told CBS News which is the BBC's media partner in North America.

Trump has so far DECLINED 🙅 to involve the US military directly offering instead to assist with intelligence and targeting support the sources said while a senior Trump administration official later told the BBC we are in continuous DIALOGUE 🗣️ with Saudi Arabia and the Republic of Yemen government regarding regional stability like they're all trying not to bust too early 🌋. On Friday Yemeni pro-government forces WITHDREW 🏃 from Perim also known as Mayyun and witnesses plus news agencies reported that Houthi forces MOVED ONTO 🏃‍♂️ the island turning it into their latest conquest trophy 🏆. The Houthis later issued a statement saying that their military operation to expel Saudi-backed forces had been a SUCCESS 🥇 and that maritime navigation is safe for all companies except for Saudi vessels so basically everyone else can keep SLIDING THROUGH 🛟 while Riyadh gets the cold shoulder 🥶.

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Sarea said the large-scale military operation was launched on 3 September due to Saudi Arabia's blatant aggression against our dear people and that the Houthis had EXPELLED 🚪 Saudi enemy forces from six districts in the Taiz and Hodeidah regions claiming that hundreds of troops had been killed wounded or captured in what sounds like a total CLAPBACK 👏 for the ages!! The Houthi statement however did not mention Perim Island even though everyone and their mom knows they just SNATCHED 🖐️ that rock right out of the coalition's hands leaving Saudi Arabia with no public COMMENT 📢 on the latest developments which is basically them staring at the ceiling trying to process the nut 🥜 they just took. Perim Island sits at the narrowest point of the Bab al-Mandab Strait which has become increasingly IMPORTANT 📈 following the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz another crucial waterway in the conflict between the US and Iran so now the whole oil flow is getting funneled through Houthi-controlled waters like a horny bottleneck 🍾.

Saudi Arabia has been relying on the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandab Strait for shipping oil to customers in Asia and this escalation of the conflict between the Houthis Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia has contributed to a SURGE 📈 in oil prices hitting 100 bucks a barrel for the first time since July after all these US and Houthi strikes left the market absolutely THROBBING 💓!! Hundreds of people have reportedly been killed and thousands displaced in Yemen since the Houthis launched an offensive in the south-west a week ago with the International Organization for Migration screaming that at least 46,000 people have been displaced and the number is alarmingly rising by the hour like families are fleeing for the second or third time with almost nothing left according to IOM director general Amy Pope. A Saudi-led coalition has also carried out air strikes on Houthi-controlled areas in western Yemen in support of the pro-government forces and the Houthis have launched missiles and drones at cities and oil facilities in southern Saudi Arabia keeping the whole region locked in this endless back-and-forth RAILING 💦 match that just collapsed the four-year truce in July after the Houthis ousted the internationally-recognised government back in 2015.
